name: Shenzhou 9 Guidao Cang
about: Shenzhou 9 Guidao Cang (2012-032H), a crewed vehicle (Shenzhou OM), launched 2012 Jun 16. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (R).
